summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an extension of its tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Genco Shipping & Trading not already owned by Diana. The offer is $27.34 per share, comprising $24.80 cash plus one Diana share valued at $2.54, representing a 53% premium to Genco's undisturbed price. As of June 26, 10,583,484 shares (28.4% of outstanding not owned by Diana) were tendered. The offer is supported by $1.433 billion in committed financing from six banks with no financing condition. The extended tender expires July 10, 2026. Watch for potential negotiated deal with Genco board and regulatory clearance.
